name: Default
shortDescription: Self-hosted tournament system for round-robin, single elimination and Swiss formats, with a Next.js frontend, FastAPI backend and PostgreSQL.

alerts.message: Sign in with ADMIN_EMAIL and ADMIN_PASSWORD from the environment variables. Public sign-up is off; set ALLOW_USER_REGISTRATION to true to let others create accounts.
The API is served on the api. subdomain of the app domain, so that subdomain must resolve to this server too.
